task_description: Apply concrete Arch Linux and Omarchy (basecamp/omarchy) inspiration to SigmaOS: a consolidated design-philosophy module in the umbrella Rust core, elevation of the most relevant desktop/package component scaffolds to coherent Arch/Omarchy-inspired functionality, and wiki documentation of the design philosophy and the changes.
